capabilities: Preview glsl code blocks as live fragment shaders
Load vault images as textures on iChannel0-3
Reuse shader setups through template files
Configure shaders with comment directives like @autoplay and @hideCode
extras: Shadertoy compatibility is described as limited; only fragment shaders with a mainImage entry point are supported.
problem: Obsidian code blocks only show shader code as text; there is no way to run and view GLSL shaders inside a note.

relations.evidence: Same syntax as Shadertoy - easily port your creations and reuse code snippets between platforms
Works with syntax highlighters: No conflicts with other code plugins (Shiki Highlighter)

summary: Shader previewer that renders glsl code blocks as live GLSL fragment shaders with Shadertoy-compatible uniforms, vault textures, and templates.
